name: Hu Xin Ting Qitan Ji
source:
On a sultry night in late August, I ran into a man carrying a peony lantern at the Mid-Lake Pavilion. In the hazy and dim light, the man told the odd and bizarre stories. Under the overcast rainy sky, the moon setting horizontally, you will be brought into a perplexing, weird, and supernatural world.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
八月下旬一个闷热的夜晚，我在湖心亭遇见了一个提着牡丹灯的男人。朦胧昏暗的灯光下，男人讲述着一些离奇古怪的故事。阴雨绵绵的天空下，明月横斜，你将被带入一个扑朔迷离、诡异超自然的世界。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1796180/]Steam[/url]]
